in_english.name: Ajeeba
in_english.meaning: One who is called by their Lord
in_english.long_meaning: Ajeeba, one who is called by their Lord, is a name that reflects the concept of being summoned by Allah, the Almighty. In Islamic tradition, the name Ajeeba is associated with the concept of being obedient to Allah and responding to His call. The name Ajeeba is derived from the Arabic root AJB, which means to respond or to obey. In the Quran, the term Ajeeba is used to describe those who respond to Allah's call and obey His commands. The name Ajeeba is also associated with the concept of being humble and submissive to Allah's will. In Islamic culture, the name Ajeeba is considered a blessed name, as it reflects the values of obedience, humility, and submission to Allah's will.

At face value, the name might seem to carry a negative connotation, but it actually celebrates the individuality and uniqueness of a person. It could be used as a term of endearment or admiration for someone who defies the ordinary and stands out from the crowd.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual context, the name "Ajeeba" can be seen as a reminder of the infinite and mysterious nature of God. The Quran describes God as "The Unseen" (Al-Ghaffar), who is beyond human comprehension and beyond the grasp of logic and reason. The name "Ajeeba" can serve as a reminder of the paradoxical nature of God, who is both familiar and unfamiliar, and who transcends all human understanding. It also emphasizes the importance of open-mindedness and a childlike wonder towards the mysteries of faith.
